landing.title: Earn a commission on every customer you bring to Frost
landing.subtitle: Share your personal link, follow every click, sign-up and payment in real time, and get paid for the customers who subscribe.
landing.step.apply.title: Apply
landing.step.apply.body: Send a short application. Our team reviews it and assigns your plan.
landing.step.share.title: Share your link
landing.step.share.body: You get a personal link and code, plus campaign links with UTM tracking.
landing.step.convert.title: Customers subscribe
landing.step.convert.body: Sign-ups from your link are attributed to you on the server, with fraud checks.
landing.step.paid.title: Get paid
landing.step.paid.body: Commissions are released after the hold period and paid to your chosen method.
landing.plansHint: Each plan sets your commission rate and which tools you can use.
landing.noPlans: Partner plans will be published soon.
